title: Insight Set
description: Stage 4 output - the analysed read, written by the model against Stage 3's analysis and verbatim worksheet. Everything here is checked mechanically in Stage 5: evidence must resolve, blind spots must be declared, insights must be anchored to the timeline.

headline.description: One sentence a sponsor could repeat verbatim in a steerco

themes.description: Qualitative codes over the verbatims. A theme is a claim about what people said, so it needs the quotes that make it true.

label.description: In the respondents' language where possible, not consultant register

signal_ids.description: At least two - one person's complaint is an anecdote, not a theme

prevalence.description: e.g. '14 of 62 verbatims (23%)' - counted, not estimated

illustrative_quote.description: Verbatim, from one of the cited signal_ids

counter_signal.description: What in the data cuts against this theme. Write it or say 'none found'.

headline.description: The finding, stated as a claim with its number in it

so_what.description: The consequence for the programme, not a restatement of the finding

analysis_cells.description: Cell IDs from analysis.json, e.g. 'A:confidence:Field Ops'

confidence.description: Low is the honest answer for a thin base or a single low-response-rate source. Stage 5 forces it in those cases.

milestone_id.description: The dated thing this bears on. Required unless not_time_bound.

not_time_bound.description: Set only for findings with no deadline consequence at all. Stage 5 requires one or the other.

remediation_lead_time_days.description: Working days the recommended action realistically needs. Compared against days to the milestone.

recommended_action.description: Something a named person could start on Monday

gap.description: true when the programme needs this answered and the feedback cannot answer it

gap_note.description: Required when gap is true - what is missing and what would close it

blind_spots.description: Every segment x dimension cell with no data or a base too thin to read. Generated from Stage 3's coverage matrix and kept - silence must never render as green.
